figures.alt: Bathroom tile floor with selected grout joints cleared for repair
figures.caption: Open joints only make sense to regrout when the tile remains sound. A hollow, loose, or moisture-driven floor needs the cause addressed before a cosmetic finish.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Bathroom floor opening with a stainless toilet flange repair ring
figures.caption: Fixture openings are one place to observe how the finished floor plane, grout joints, and penetrations work together. Grout should not be asked to correct movement.

figures.alt: Clear shower-door side seal closing evenly against a tiled bathroom jamb
figures.caption: New grout and adjacent wet-area seals need their full cure period. Humidity and poor ventilation can make an otherwise neat repair fail early.
